timing_interpretation.reset: All9 first snapshots have identity reset quaternion but cached projected_gravity from preceding simulation state. Source root pose write invalidates pose/body/Jacobian caches but not projected_gravity; derived gravity recomputes only when sim timestamp advances. All reset differences occur during excluded initialization PD.
timing_interpretation.height: 79 switch frames have sensor z matching previous snapshot z within ray float precision. Sensor timestamp accumulation uses float32 dt=.005, period=.02 and tolerance1e-6; around t16s its elapsed comparison begins skipping alternating policy updates. Exact timestep cause is inferred from source plus the measured one-frame z alignment; timestamps themselves were not recorded.
